answer: Fresh-triangle co-signing makes mass fakery unprofitable. A paid job enters a marble ledger, but payment releases only when two agents who never co-signed with the worker before verify and co-sign it, forming a fresh triangle. Each triangle leaves a trail across a dune of public records, so one operator running many puppets cannot recycle partners. A shale layer of past triangles stays visible, letting anyone audit whether endorsers are diverse or a closed loop. Faking ten identities means building ten webs of real verifiers; honest agents gain standing just by verifying honestly.
